summary: Full frontend regression against production-readiness checklist items 21-22 and new pages. All hero animations resolve to opacity=1 within 2-3s (BUG 21 & 22 verified fixed). Home /, /opulence, /greens heroes fully visible at desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844: symbol, wordmark, RERA text, subtitle, price chips, all CTA buttons and stat boxes present. Custom 404 at /random-url-xyz shows 'This level hasn't been built yet.' and BACK TO HOME navigates to /. Privacy (/privacy) and Terms (/terms) render with proper titles + legal content; footer contains PRIVACY & TERMS anchors linking correctly. /enquire FAQ section present (faq-section), faq-item-0 expands answer 'Ultra-premium 3 & 4 BHK residences start from ₹1.41 Cr...' and collapses on second click. CookieConsent banner (cookie-consent) visible on first load, cookie-accept-btn dismisses it, localStorage['pg-cookie-consent']='accepted', stays dismissed after reload. robots.txt and sitemap.xml return 200 with valid content (site's own content is served; note Cloudflare Managed Content preamble is prepended by hosting layer — not a code issue). Meta: distinct <title> per route (Platinum Group — Ultra-Premium Residences in Jaipur / Platinum Greens Opulence — 3 & 4 BHK... / Platinum Greens — Ready-to-Move... / Privacy Policy / Terms & Conditions), canonical & og:image meta present. Lead form on /enquire: filling name+10-digit mobile+Platinum Greens+Book a Site Visit and submitting shows 'REQUEST RECEIVED' success state. Nav items HOME/GREENS/GREENS OPULENCE/PROJECTS/ENQUIRE all route without 404. No console errors; only benign warnings (framer-motion 'non-static position' hint on one section, and preload-unused warnings for opulence-wordmark/greens-wordmark/opulence-symbol .webp on home page).
action_items: Minor: index.html preloads opulence-wordmark.webp / greens-wordmark.webp / opulence-symbol.webp on every route, but home page doesn't use them within ~seconds → browser prints 'preloaded but not used' warning. Consider route-scoped preloads or drop these preloads on home to remove noise.

Minor: framer-motion useScroll warning 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position' still present on home — locate the section using useScroll and add position:relative explicitly (benign but pollutes console).
critical_code_review_comments: Cookie consent test passed but banner text is quite small (13-14px?) at desktop — verify contrast/legibility on light-vision users; acceptable but consider p-4 min-h.
Preload strategy in index.html is global — for large multi-page SPA better to preload per-route using route data or React 18 useEffect with <link rel=preload> injection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 13 checklist items pass. Ascent intro shows on first ever visit (~4s) — set sessionStorage 'pg-ascent'='1' before goto to skip. Cookie key = localStorage 'pg-cookie-consent'. Lead-form success state shows 'REQUEST RECEIVED' heading and 'CONTINUE ON WHATSAPP' button. Data-testids inventory captured in iteration 2 output for reuse.
